001: Sergey, have you already decided when you'll take your vacation this summer?
I'm still deciding between July and August, but I want to make it before the big project starts.
And where are you planning to go, if it all works out?
I'm dreaming of Lake Baikal, but the tickets are really expensive right now.
That's true, prices always go up in the high season.
That's why I'm waiting, maybe I'll manage to find a good deal.
002: Ivan, how did your business trip to Saint Petersburg go?
Very productive, but I'm completely exhausted after those three days.
I bet there were lots of meetings and little time for rest?
Exactly, every day was scheduled down to the minute from morning to night.
I hope you at least got to try the local cuisine.
Unfortunately, barely any, but I'll definitely go back there on vacation.
003: Have you already submitted your vacation request or not yet?
Not yet, I'm waiting for the manager to approve the annual schedule.
And when do they usually approve the schedule in your department?
Usually at the end of the month, but this year everything is being delayed.
That's a pain, since you need to make summer plans in advance.
I agree, but I hope everything gets settled next week.
004: Dmitry, I heard you went on a business trip to Kazan? How was it?
The city is beautiful, but the work was very intense.
So there was no time left for sightseeing at all?
Actually, I set aside one evening specifically to walk around the Kremlin.
That's a great decision, you should always make time for new places.
I agree, otherwise the trip just turns into nonstop work.
005: Maria, have you already picked a country for your vacation this year?
Yes, I want to go to Georgia, I've been drawn there for a long time.
Great choice, the nature and the food there are wonderful.
I've heard that in autumn it's especially beautiful there and not so hot.
Exactly, September is considered the golden season in those parts.
That's why I'm planning to take my vacation in the middle of September.
006: Olga, how do you manage to balance business trips and family?
Honestly, it's really hard, but we try to plan everything in advance.
I bet the kids miss you when you're away for a long time?
Of course they do, but we video call every evening.
That's a good way to stay connected from a distance.
Yes, and I also always bring them small gifts from my trips.
007: Alexey, have you ever taken a vacation in winter?
Usually no, but this year I'm thinking of making an exception.
And where do you want to go during the cold season?
I want to go to the mountains, go skiing and get some fresh air.
Sounds wonderful, I also love an active vacation.
Then join me, it'll be much more fun together.
008: Elena, how did your trip to Sochi go? You'd been waiting for it for so long.
Everything was wonderful, but unfortunately, the vacation flew by too fast.
It's always like that, time goes by much faster on vacation.
Exactly, before I knew it, it was already time to go back.
But at least now you have wonderful memories and photos.
Yes, and I'm already making plans for the next trip.
009: Sergey, do you regret taking unpaid leave?
A little, but I really needed to take care of some personal matters.
I understand, sometimes those things are more important than money.
Exactly, health and family should always come first.
I completely agree with you, that's the right approach.
The main thing is that I got everything done, and now I can calmly get back to work.
010: Anna, do you already know where you'll go on your next vacation?
I'm dreaming of a trip to Kaliningrad, but I'm still just gathering information.
That's an interesting destination, there's a lot of European architecture there.
Yes, I'm especially drawn to the historic center and the Baltic Sea.
I think you'll really love it there, especially in summer.
I hope so, I can't wait to hit the road.
